query: SELECT pc.id, pc.mes, pc.ano, COUNT(idi.id) as qtd_itens FROM periodo_custo pc LEFT JOIN item_despesa_importado idi ON idi.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE pc.ano = 2026 AND pc.mes IN (1,2,3,4) GROUP BY pc.id, pc.mes, pc.ano ORDER BY pc.mes
